title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper MetoHash: A Memory-Efficient and Traffic-Optimized Hashing Index on Hybrid PMem-DRAM Memories
problem: Artifact evaluation and reproducibility assessment of hybrid persistent memory-DRAM hashing index
motivation: Reproducibility is critical for validating systems and data structures research; this report documents evaluation of MetoHash artifact following SC25 standards
method: The team tested MetoHash—a data-structure index for hybrid memory systems combining persistent memory (PMem, which survives power loss) with DRAM—by running it on actual hardware. They measured two things: how much memory MetoHash used and how efficiently it moved data between the PMem and DRAM layers. They followed SC25 reproducibility standards, meaning they documented every test step, reported all results transparently, and ensured that other researchers could independently run the same tests and get the same answers.
key_novelty: This work independently confirms that MetoHash's hybrid memory hashing design achieves its claimed improvements in memory efficiency and data-traffic optimization on real hardware.
contributions: Artifact evaluation report for MetoHash paper
Validation of PMem-DRAM hybrid hashing implementation
limitations: Reproducibility report only; limited details on actual performance improvements
